# spacelift_policy (List Resource)

Lists every policy in the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_child_spaces` (Boolean) With `space_id`, also list policies in its child spaces, at any depth.
- `labels` (List of String) Only list policies that have all of these labels.
- `name` (String) Only list policies whose name matches this pattern. `*` matches any characters, and case is ignored.
- `space_id` (String) Only list policies in this space.
- `type` (String) Only list policies of this type, e.g. `PLAN` or `GIT_PUSH`.
